items.name: Louisiana LNG foundation project
items.claim: A high point of 2025 was the final investment decision taken in April on the $17.5 billion three-train, 16.5 million tonne per annum foundation Louisiana LNG project, which was 22% complete at year-end and on target for first LNG in 2029.
items.source_excerpt: A high point of 2025 was the final investment decision taken in April on the $17.5 billion three-train, 16.5 million tonne per annum foundation Louisiana LNG project, which was 22% complete at year-end and on target for first LNG in 2029.

items.name: Scarborough Energy Project
items.claim: Scarborough was 94% complete at year-end with the floating production unit arriving on location in Australia in January 2026, and is on track for first LNG cargo in the fourth quarter of 2026.
items.source_excerpt: Scarborough was 94% complete at year-end with the floating production unit arriving on location in Australia in January 2026. Scarborough is on track for first LNG cargo in the fourth quarter of 2026.

items.name: Trion oil development
items.claim: Woodside said its Trion oil development stayed on schedule for first oil in 2028, having reached 50% completion at year end.
items.source_excerpt: Trion remains on target for first oil in 2028, with the project 50% complete at year end.
